intro: Lesson 48: Section C exam questions: 3.1 to 3.5. To understand how to answer Section C questions on the five pillars with set passages

questions.q: Explain two benefits of Hajj for Muslims. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Spiritual: forgiveness and closeness to Allah, following Ibrahim; social: unity of millions of Muslims of every race in one dress.
questions.model: Point 1: spiritual renewal. Develop: Hajj with no obscenity or wrongdoing is commanded (2:197), and pilgrims seek forgiveness. Point 2: unity. Develop: ihram makes rich and poor equal before Allah.

questions.q: Who is exempt from fasting and makes it up later?
Section C set 1 on the pupil PDF (our own questions): four 4-mark questions on 3.1 to 3.5 and one 12-mark: 'Zakah is more important than sawm.' Assess. Timed: 25 minutes.
questions.a: Mark-scheme style answers; set passages used; justified judgement
questions.model: Teacher answers the first 4-mark question aloud.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: the five pillars in one minute?
questions.a: Belief, prayer, charity, fasting and pilgrimage: a complete way of worship.
